e-4683.knowledge_point: Finding the Coefficient Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
e-4683.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
{\begin{aligned}x-2y=1 \\ 2y=-1\end{aligned}
$$
e-4683.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}x-2y=1 \\ 0x+2y=-1\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\left\lbrack
	\matrix {
		1 & -2 \
		0 & 2 
	}
	\right\rbrack
$$

e-4684.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
e-4684.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
{\begin{aligned}y+x-5-3z=0 \\ z=y+7x \\ y+3-2z=1-2x\end{aligned}
$$
e-4684.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}x+y-3z=5 \\ -7x-y+z=0 \\ 2x+y-2z=-2\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\left\lbrack
	\matrix {
		1 & 1 & -3 \
		-7 & -1 & 1 \
                2 & 1 & -2 
	}
	\right\rbrack
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -3 & 5 \\ -7 & -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & -2 & -2\end{aligned}
$$

e-4685.knowledge_point: Finding the System of Equations Associated With an Augmented Matrix
e-4685.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
\begin{aligned}5 & -4 & -12 \\ 3 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}
$$
e-4685.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$ and $y,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is

$$
\begin{aligned}5x-4y=-12 \\ 3x+y=1.\end{aligned}
$$

e-4686.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a Linear System With Variables Other Than x, y, z
e-4686.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
{\begin{aligned}\frac{c}{2}=a \\ 5+3b-a=4c \\ d=1\end{aligned}
$$
e-4686.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $a,b,c,d$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}-a+0b+\frac{1}{2}c+0d=0 \\ -a+3b-4c+0d=-5 \\ 0a+0b+0c+d=1\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & \frac{1}{2} & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & -4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & \frac{1}{2} & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & -4 & 0 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}
$$

after.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-2y=1 \\ 3x=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered  $x,y$ 
 on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient: 

$$
{\begin{aligned}0x-2y=1 \\ 3x+0y=-1\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & -2 \\ 3 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Coefficient Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
content.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-2y=1 \\ 3x=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered  $x,y$ 
 on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient: 

$$
{\begin{aligned}0x-2y=1 \\ 3x+0y=-1\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & -2 \\ 3 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

{x+2y=3−4y+5z=67x+8z=9

[12−3−45−678−9]

[1200−45708]

e

Submit

decision.explanation: Order the columns as x, y, z and use zero for missing variables. The three coefficient rows are (1,2,0), (0,-4,5), and (7,0,8). Constants are excluded.

after.name: Question 2
after.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+2y=3 \\ -4y+5z=6 \\ 7x+8z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+2y+0z=3 \\ 0x-4y+5z=6 \\ 7x+0y+8z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & \,\,\,-4 & 5 \\ 7 & 0 & 8\end{aligned}]
$$

Question 2
?

What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

{x+2y=3−4y+5z=67x+8z=9

a
[12−3−45−678−9]
b
[1200−45708]
c
[123−456789]
d
[1072−40058]
e
[12030−4567089]
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered x,y,z on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

{x+2y+0z=30x−4y+5z=67x+0y+8z=9

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

[1200−45708]

verification.explanation: The worked solution confirms option b. With columns ordered x, y, z, the coefficient rows are (1,2,0), (0,-4,5), and (7,0,8). Missing variables have coefficient zero, and right-hand constants are excluded.

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Coefficient Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
content.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+2y=3 \\ -4y+5z=6 \\ 7x+8z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:

What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}3x-2y=0 \\ 5x+y=1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 \\ 5 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Coefficient Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
content.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-x+2y=0 \\ -5x-3y=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ -5 & -3\end{aligned}]
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x+y=0 \\ x+9y=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 1 & 9\end{aligned}]
$$

decision.explanation: Rewrite the equations as 2x-3y=5 and -4x+y=-6. The augmented matrix includes the x and y coefficients followed by the right-hand constants, giving option c.

after.name: Question 6
after.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-5=3y \\ 6+y=4x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-3y=5 \\ -4x+y=-6\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 \\ -4 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 & 5 \\ -4 & 1 & -6\end{aligned}]
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-5=3y \\ 6+y=4x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-3y=5 \\ -4x+y=-6\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 \\ -4 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 & 5 \\ -4 & 1 & -6\end{aligned}]
$$

after.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x-3=2y \\ 1+y=-2x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x-2y=3 \\ 2x+y=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ 2 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations: 

$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x-3=2y \\ 1+y=-2x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x-2y=3 \\ 2x+y=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ 2 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 \\ 2 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

decision.explanation: Order the columns as x, y, z, then the constant. The first row is (6,1,1,4); the second is (1,0,1,9), since y is absent. This matches option a.

after.name: Question 8
after.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}6x+y+z=4 \\ x+z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}6x+y+z=4 \\ x+0y+z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}6 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}6 & 1 & 1 & 4 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 & 9\end{aligned}]
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}6x+y+z=4 \\ x+z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}6x+y+z=4 \\ x+0y+z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}6 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}6 & 1 & 1 & 4 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 & 9\end{aligned}]
$$

{9x+3y−z=1615−8x=−4y−y+20x=3z

a
[9−3−116−840−1520−130]
b
[9−3116−840−1520−1−30]
c
[9−3−116−8415020−1−30]
d
[93−116−840−1520−1−30]
e
[9−3−116−840−1520−103]

decision.explanation: Arrange the equations as 9x+3y-z=16, -8x+4y+0z=-15, and 20x-y-3z=0. The augmented matrix lists the x, y, z coefficients and then the constants, matching option d.

after.name: Question 9
after.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}9x+3y-z=16 \\ 15-8x=-4y \\ -y+20x=3z\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}9x+3y-z=16 \\ -8x+4y+0z=-15 \\ 20x-y-3z=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}9 & 3 & -1 \\ -8 & 4 & 0 \\ 20 & -1 & -3\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}9 & 3 & -1 & 16 \\ -8 & 4 & 0 & -15 \\ 20 & -1 & -3 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}9x+3y-z=16 \\ 15-8x=-4y \\ -y+20x=3z\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}9x+3y-z=16 \\ -8x+4y+0z=-15 \\ 20x-y-3z=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}9 & 3 & -1 \\ -8 & 4 & 0 \\ 20 & -1 & -3\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}9 & 3 & -1 & 16 \\ -8 & 4 & 0 & -15 \\ 20 & -1 & -3 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of  linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-x+y=5 \\ x+y=6\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
Notice that the system is already organized so that the variables are in the order $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient. 

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}-1 & 1 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

 

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}-1 & 1 & 5 \\ 1 & 1 & 6\end{aligned}]
$$

Question 11
?

What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

[7−409−31503−483]

a
{7x−4y−9z=13x+y+5z=13x−4y+8z=3
b
{7x−4y=9−3x+y+5z=03x−4y+8z=3
c
{7x+4y=93x+y+5z=03x+4y+8z=3
d
{7x−4y+z=9−3x+y+5z=03x−4y+8z=3
e
{7x−4y+9z=0−3x+y+5z=03x−4y+8z=3
Submit

decision.explanation: Read each row as coefficients of x, y, z followed by the right-hand constant. This gives 7x-4y=9, -3x+y+5z=0, and 3x-4y+8z=3, matching option b.

after.name: Question 11
after.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}7 & -4 & 0 & 9 \\ -3 & 1 & 5 & 0 \\ 3 & -4 & 8 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$
after.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$, $y$, and $z,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}7x-4y+0z=9 \\ -3x+y+5z=0 \\ 3x-4y+8z=3.\end{aligned}
$$

By simplifying, we obtain

$$
{\begin{aligned}7x-4y=9 \\ -3x+y+5z=0 \\ 3x-4y+8z=3.\end{aligned}

What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

[7−409−31503−483]

a
{7x−4y−9z=13x+y+5z=13x−4y+8z=3
b

Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables x, y, and z, then, the corresponding system of equations is

{7x−4y+0z=9−3x+y+5z=03x−4y+8z=3.

By simplifying, we obtain

{7x−4y=9−3x+y+5z=03x−4y+8z=3.

content.knowledge_point: Finding the System of Equations Associated With an Augmented Matrix
content.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}7 & -4 & 0 & 9 \\ -3 & 1 & 5 & 0 \\ 3 & -4 & 8 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$
content.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$, $y$, and $z,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}7x-4y+0z=9 \\ -3x+y+5z=0 \\ 3x-4y+8z=3.\end{aligned}
$$

By simplifying, we obtain

$$
{\begin{aligned}7x-4y=9 \\ -3x+y+5z=0 \\ 3x-4y+8z=3.\end{aligned}
$$

after.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 10 \\ -1 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$
after.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$ and  $y$,  the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}x-2y=10 \\ -x+y=-2.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 13
?

What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

[023020322303]

a
{2y+3z=0x+3z=22x+3y=3
b
{2y+3z=02x+3z=22x+3y=3
c
{2y+3z=02x+3z=2x−3y=3
d
{y+3z=02x−3z=22x+3y=3
e
{2y−3z=02x+3z=22x+y=3
Submit

decision.explanation: Read the columns as x, y, z coefficients followed by constants. Omitting zero terms gives 2y+3z=0, 2x+3z=2, and 2x+3y=3, matching option b.

after.name: Question 13
after.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 3 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 3 & 2 \\ 2 & 3 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$
after.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$, $y$, and $z,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is 

$$
{\begin{aligned}0x+2y+3z=0 \\ 2x+0y+3z=2 \\ 2x+3y+0z=3.\end{aligned}
$$

By simplifying, we obtain: 

$$
{\begin{aligned}2y+3z=0 \\ 2x+3z=2 \\ 2x+3y=3\end{aligned}
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the System of Equations Associated With an Augmented Matrix
content.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 3 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 3 & 2 \\ 2 & 3 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$
content.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$, $y$, and $z,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is 

$$
{\begin{aligned}0x+2y+3z=0 \\ 2x+0y+3z=2 \\ 2x+3y+0z=3.\end{aligned}
$$

By simplifying, we obtain: 

$$
{\begin{aligned}2y+3z=0 \\ 2x+3z=2 \\ 2x+3y=3\end{aligned}
$$

before.html:
Question 14
?

What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

[212132324343]

a
{2x+y+2z=13x+y+3z=−2x+3y+4z=3
b
{2x+y+2z=13x−2y+3z=24x+3y+4z=3
c
{2x+y+2z=1x+2y+3z=24x+3y+z=3
d
{2x+y+2z=13x+2y+3z=24x+3y+4z=3
e
{2x+y−2z=13x+2y+3z=24x+3y+4z=3
Submit

decision.explanation: Each row lists the coefficients of x, y, z followed by the right-hand constant. This gives 2x+y+2z=1, 3x+2y+3z=2, and 4x+3y+4z=3, matching option d.

after.name: Question 14
after.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 3 & 2 & 3 & 2 \\ 4 & 3 & 4 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$
after.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$, $y$, and $z,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}2x+y+2z=1 \\ 3x+2y+3z=2 \\ 4x+3y+4z=3.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 14
?

What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

[212132324343]

a
{2x+y+2z=13x+y+3z=−2x+3y+4z=3
b
{2x+y+2z=13x−2y+3z=24x+3y+4z=3
c
{2x+y+2z=1x+2y+3z=24x+3y+z=3
d
{2x+y+2z=13x+2y+3z=24x+3y+4z=3
e
{2x+y−2z=13x+2y+3z=24x+3y+4z=3
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables x, y, and z, then, the corresponding system of equations is

{2x+y+2z=13x+2y+3z=24x+3y+4z=3.

verification.explanation: The revealed solution confirms option d. Reading each row as x, y, z coefficients followed by the constant gives 2x+y+2z=1, 3x+2y+3z=2, and 4x+3y+4z=3.

content.knowledge_point: Finding the System of Equations Associated With an Augmented Matrix
content.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 3 & 2 & 3 & 2 \\ 4 & 3 & 4 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$
content.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$, $y$, and $z,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}2x+y+2z=1 \\ 3x+2y+3z=2 \\ 4x+3y+4z=3.\end{aligned}
$$

before.html:
Question 15
?

What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

[1−510−2−3−15]

a
{−5x−y=10−3x−2y=−5
b
{x−5y=102x−3y=−18
c
{x−5y=1−2x−3y=−5
d
{x−5y=102x−3y=−16
e
{x−5y=10−2x−3y=−15
Submit

decision.explanation: Each row gives the x and y coefficients followed by the constant. The equations are x-5y=10 and -2x-3y=-15, matching option e.

after.name: Question 15
after.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & 10 \\ -2 & -3 & -15\end{aligned}]
$$
after.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$ and  $y$,  the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}x-5y=10 \\ -2x-3y=-15\end{aligned}
$$

after.html:
Question 15
?

What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

[1−510−2−3−15]

a
{−5x−y=10−3x−2y=−5
b
{x−5y=102x−3y=−18
c
{x−5y=1−2x−3y=−5
d
{x−5y=102x−3y=−16
e
{x−5y=10−2x−3y=−15
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables x and y, the corresponding system of equations is

{x−5y=10−2x−3y=−15

content.knowledge_point: Finding the System of Equations Associated With an Augmented Matrix
content.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & 10 \\ -2 & -3 & -15\end{aligned}]
$$
content.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$ and  $y$,  the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}x-5y=10 \\ -2x-3y=-15\end{aligned}
$$

decision.explanation: Using columns m, n, and the constant, rewrite the equations as (1/3)m+5n=11, -4n=-8, and 6m+n=2/5. These give option e; the second equation is equivalent to 4n=8.

after.name: Question 16
after.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3}m+5n=11 \\ 0=4n-8 \\ n=-6m+\frac{2}{5}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $m,n$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3}m+5n=11 \\ 0m-4n=-8 \\ 6m+n=\frac{2}{5}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3} & 5 \\ 0 & -4 \\ 6 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3} & 5 & 11 \\ 0 & -4 & -8 \\ 6 & 1 & \frac{2}{5}\end{aligned}]
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a Linear System With Variables Other Than x, y, z
content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3}m+5n=11 \\ 0=4n-8 \\ n=-6m+\frac{2}{5}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $m,n$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3}m+5n=11 \\ 0m-4n=-8 \\ 6m+n=\frac{2}{5}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3} & 5 \\ 0 & -4 \\ 6 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3} & 5 & 11 \\ 0 & -4 & -8 \\ 6 & 1 & \frac{2}{5}\end{aligned}]
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a Linear System With Variables Other Than x, y, z
content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}=-5 \\ 5{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}=-3\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
Notice that the system is already organized so that the variables are in the order ${x}_{1},{x}_{2}$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient.   

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 \\ 5 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & -5 \\ 5 & 3 & -3\end{aligned}]
$$

decision.explanation: Order the variables a, b, c. The equations become a-4b-c=0 and -11a+0b+3c=-1. Appending the constants gives option e.

after.name: Question 18
after.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations? 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}a-c=4b \\ 3c-11a=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $a,b,c$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}a-4b-c=0 \\ -11a+0b+3c=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -4 & -1 \\ -11 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -4 & -1 & 0 \\ -11 & 0 & 3 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a Linear System With Variables Other Than x, y, z
content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations? 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}a-c=4b \\ 3c-11a=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $a,b,c$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}a-4b-c=0 \\ -11a+0b+3c=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -4 & -1 \\ -11 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -4 & -1 & 0 \\ -11 & 0 & 3 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

after.name: Question 19
after.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}\frac{7}{2}a=6b \\ 2a-7b=5 \\ 2a-4b+\frac{3}{2}=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $a,b$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}\frac{7}{2}a-6b=0 \\ 2a-7b=5 \\ 2a-4b=-\frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}\frac{7}{2} & -6 \\ 2 & -7 \\ 2 & -4\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}\frac{7}{2} & -6 & 0 \\ 2 & -7 & 5 \\ 2 & -4 & -\frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}]
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a Linear System With Variables Other Than x, y, z
content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}\frac{7}{2}a=6b \\ 2a-7b=5 \\ 2a-4b+\frac{3}{2}=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $a,b$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}\frac{7}{2}a-6b=0 \\ 2a-7b=5 \\ 2a-4b=-\frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}\frac{7}{2} & -6 \\ 2 & -7 \\ 2 & -4\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}\frac{7}{2} & -6 & 0 \\ 2 & -7 & 5 \\ 2 & -4 & -\frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}]
$$

decision.explanation: Order the columns as x₁, x₂, x₃. The equations become 4x₁+2x₂-3x₃=0 and 0x₁+0x₂-11x₃=12. Excluding constants gives option a.

after.name: Question 20
after.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2{x}_{2}+4{x}_{1}=3{x}_{3} \\ -11{x}_{3}=12\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},{x}_{3}$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}-3{x}_{3}=0 \\ 0{x}_{1}+0{x}_{2}-11{x}_{3}=12\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & -11\end{aligned}]
$$
